name: AUTOPILOT.OI Raise Agent
description_html:
Build your case for a raise and practice until it feels easy.

A Claude agent that turns your messy notes into clear wins with numbers, shows you where to find real pay data for your job and city, helps you pick a specific number, writes your one page case and the meeting email, and plays your manager with realistic pushback.

What you get (14 page agent pack, PDF): a setup builder that installs the agent with you, setup questions, full agent instructions, the worked example from our reel, templates and a tracker.

How it works: it runs inside a Claude Project. It builds the case and coaches; you have the conversation. It does not contact anyone and does not guarantee a result.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works) and your notes about this year's work.

Education only. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
